claims.text: The proposed method is compared with previous work on reducing out-of-vocabulary (OOV) rates, specifically referencing methods that adjust translation granularity or expand vocabulary size.
The method is also compared with two previous methods: subword and fully character-based approaches, which address similar problems in NMT.
Previous work has considered morphological information in both statistical machine translation (SMT) and NMT, which the new method builds upon.
